data.content_ref: inline:Reformulate the skeptical fixed point as evaluation of a monotone boolean circuit of depth O(log n) and size O(n^2), preserving determinism and polynomial cost while reducing worst-case depth. This is a complexity-theoretic strengthening that makes the extension cheaper to compute at scale without new semantic artifacts, but is criticizable because the skeptical semantics' non-monotone defeat structure may not admit such a shallow monotone circuit, and the claimed size bound may fail for dense attack graphs.
